title: Feature change waits for valid evidence
description: A source change is MEDIUM even though the requester declared LOW. Review routes it to EVIDENCE_PENDING until a passing test report exists; a failing report does not count.

steps.content: Simulated test inventory: search_by_tag, search_empty_tag, search_unknown_tag, search_mixed_case_tag

steps.note: declared LOW is ignored: edit_source on src/** is MEDIUM
